mapper.select:
SELECT p.id FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id=p.shop_id JOIN users u ON u.id=s.seller_id WHERE p.status='ON_SHELF' AND s.status='OPEN' AND u.deleted=false AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') AND p.shop_id=#{shopId} AND p.category_id=#{categoryId} ORDER BY
p.price ASC, p.price DESC, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id=p.id AND o.status='CONFIRMED' AND oi.settlement_status!='REFUNDED') DESC, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN r.product_stars >=4 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id=r.item_id WHERE oi.product_id=p.id AND r.direction='BUYER'),0) DESC,
p.id DESC
